## Seccionaes censales ayuntamiento Madrid

```{r}
# URL del archivo KML
url_kml <- "https://datos.madrid.es/egob/catalogo/300724-12600124-Seccionado-censal-mapas.kml"

# Leer directamente desde la URL
secciones_municipio <- st_read(url_kml)
```

```{r}
columnas_activas <- c("Name", # "description", "timestamp", "begin", "end", 
                      # "altitudeMode", "tessellate", "extrude", "visibility", 
                      # "drawOrder", "icon", 
                      "COD_DIS", "NOM_DIS", "COD_BAR", "NOM_BAR", "COD_SECCIO", 
                      # "VALUNICOS", 
                      "MESAN", "ELECTO", "LOCAL_ELEC", 
                      # "FCH_ALTA", "FCH_BAJA", "ACUERDO", "OBSERVACIO", 
                      "Shape_Leng", "Shape_Area", # "snippet", 
                      "geometry")
```

```{r}
secciones_municipio <- secciones_municipio[, columnas_activas]
```

```{r}

secciones_municipio$ELECTO     <- as.numeric(secciones_municipio$ELECTO)
secciones_municipio$LOCAL_ELEC <- as.numeric(secciones_municipio$LOCAL_ELEC)
secciones_municipio$Shape_Leng <- as.numeric(secciones_municipio$Shape_Leng)
secciones_municipio$Shape_Area <- as.numeric(secciones_municipio$Shape_Area)
```

```{r}
secciones_municipio$COD_DIS    <- as.factor(secciones_municipio$COD_DIS)
secciones_municipio$NOM_DIS    <- as.factor(secciones_municipio$NOM_DIS)
secciones_municipio$COD_BAR    <- as.factor(secciones_municipio$COD_BAR)
secciones_municipio$NOM_BAR    <- as.factor(secciones_municipio$NOM_BAR)
secciones_municipio$COD_SECCIO <- as.factor(secciones_municipio$COD_SECCIO)
secciones_municipio$MESAN      <- as.factor(secciones_municipio$MESAN)
```

## Gisco

```{r}
# madrid <- gisco_get_lau(
#   country = "ES",
#   year = "2024"
# )

madrid <- gisco_get_lau(
  country = "ES",
  year = "2021"
)
```

```{r}
summary(madrid)
```


```{r}
# Filtramos la ciudad de Madrid (código LAU 28079)
madrid_lines <- madrid[madrid$LAU_ID == "28079", ]
```

```{r}
madrid_lines <- st_transform(madrid_lines, crs(eurodem_terra))
```

```{r}
# Recortar a la extensión de Madrid
eurodem_terra_crop <- crop(eurodem_terra, vect(madrid_lines))

# Aplicar máscara para dejar solo los píxeles dentro del municipio
eurodem_madrid <- mask(eurodem_terra_crop, vect(madrid_lines))
```

```{r}
# Get shapes
# nuts3 <- gisco_get_nuts(
#   year = "2024",
#   # epsg = "4326",
#   epsg = "3035",
#   resolution = "01",
#   country = "ES",
#   nuts_level = "3"
# )

nuts3 <- gisco_get_nuts(
  year = "2024",
  # epsg = "4326",
  epsg = "3035",
  resolution = "01",
  country = "ES",
  nuts_level = "3"
)

# Group by NUTS by country and convert to lines
country_lines <- nuts3 %>%
  group_by(
    CNTR_CODE
  ) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING")

madrid_lines <- nuts3 %>%
  filter(
    NAME_LATN == "Madrid"
  ) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING")
```

```{r}
# Use eurostat
library(eurostat)
popdens <- get_eurostat("demo_r_d3dens") %>%
  filter(TIME_PERIOD == "2023-01-01")
```

```{r}

```


```{r}
#| fig-align: center

# Merge data
nuts3_sf <- nuts3 %>%
  left_join(popdens, by = "geo")

nuts3_sf <- nuts3 %>%
  left_join(popdens, by = c("NUTS_ID" = "geo"))


# Breaks and labels

br <- c(0, 25, 50, 100, 200, 500, 1000, 2500, 5000, 10000, 30000)
labs <- prettyNum(br[-1], big.mark = ",")

# Label function to be used in the plot, mainly for NAs
labeller_plot <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "No Data", x)
}

nuts3_sf <- nuts3_sf %>%
  # Cut with labels
  mutate(values_cut = cut(values, br, labels = labs))


# Palette
pal <- hcl.colors(length(labs), "Lajolla")


# Plot
ggplot(nuts3_sf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = values_cut), linewidth = 0, color = NA, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_sf(data = country_lines, col = "black", linewidth = 0.1) +
  # Center in Europe: EPSG 3035
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(1547350, 3833006),
    ylim = c(941696, 2467224)
  ) +
  # coord_sf(
  #   xlim = c(2377294, 7453440),
  #   ylim = c(1313597, 5628510)
  # ) +    
  # Center in Europe: EPSG 3035
  # coord_sf(
  #   xlim = c(3171940, 3152301),
  #   ylim = c(2037920, 2024584)
  # ) +    
  # Legends
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = pal,
    # Label for NA
    labels = labeller_plot,
    drop = FALSE, guide = guide_legend(direction = "horizontal", nrow = 1)
  ) +
  # Theming
  theme_void() +
  # Theme
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      color = rev(pal)[2], size = rel(1.5),
      hjust = 0.5, vjust = -6
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      color = rev(pal)[2], size = rel(1.25),
      hjust = 0.5, vjust = -10, face = "bold"
    ),
    plot.caption = element_text(color = "grey60", hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "grey20", hjust = .5),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "grey20", hjust = .5),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title.position = "top",
    legend.text.position = "bottom",
    legend.key.height = unit(.5, "line"),
    legend.key.width = unit(2.5, "line")
  ) +
  # Annotate and labs
  labs(
    title = "Population density in 2023",
    subtitle = "NUTS-3 level",
    fill = "people per sq. kilometer",
    caption = paste0(
      "Source: Eurostat, ", gisco_attributions(),
      "\nBased on Milos Popovic: ",
      "https://milospopovic.net/how-to-make-choropleth-map-in-r/"
    )
  )
```


## Secciones censales

Distritos.

```{r}
distritos <- spod_get_zones("distritos", ver = 2)
distritos_wgs84 <- distritos |>
    sf::st_simplify(dTolerance = 200) |>
    sf::st_transform(4326)
```

```{r}
madrid_zones <- zonebuilder::zb_zone("Madrid")

distritos_madrid <- distritos_wgs84[madrid_zones, ]

plot(distritos_madrid)
```

```{r}
distritos_madrid_2 <- distritos_madrid[distritos_madrid$municipalities == "28079", ]
```

                                      stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
```

# name        : eurodem 
# min value   :    -244 
# max value   :    4800 
```










```{r}
#| eval: false

# =============================
# 1. Cargar librerías
# =============================
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(giscoR)

# =============================
# 2. Cargar el raster (EuroDEM)
# =============================
# Admite RasterLayer (raster) o SpatRaster (terra)
eurodem_raster <- terra::rast("/media/enero/Disco3ATA/Varios/R/Archivos/GIS/data/eurogeographics/EuroDEM/euro-dem-tif/data/eurodem/eurodem.tif")

# =============================
# 3. Descargar geometría (Madrid)
# =============================
# madrid_sf <- gisco_get_lau(country = "ES", year = "2024")
madrid_sf <- gisco_get_lau(country = "ES", year = "2021")
madrid_sf <- madrid_sf[madrid_sf$LAU_CODE == "28079", ]  # Municipio de Madrid

# =============================
# 4. Validar y reproyectar geometría
# =============================
# Validar geometría
madrid_sf <- st_make_valid(madrid_sf)

# Transformar al CRS del raster si no coincide
if (sf::st_crs(madrid_sf)$epsg != terra::crs(eurodem_raster, describe = TRUE)$code) {
  message("Reproyectando geometría al CRS del raster...")
  madrid_sf <- st_transform(madrid_sf, crs(eurodem_raster))
}

# =============================
# 5. Convertir a SpatVector (terra)
# =============================
madrid_vect <- terra::vect(madrid_sf)

# =============================
# 6. Comprobar cobertura antes de recortar
# =============================
if (is.null(intersect(ext(eurodem_raster), ext(madrid_vect)))) {
  stop("El raster no cubre Madrid. Verifica que usas el EuroDEM completo.")
}

# =============================
# 7. Recorte (crop + mask)
# =============================
eurodem_crop <- terra::crop(eurodem_raster, madrid_vect)
eurodem_madrid <- terra::mask(eurodem_crop, madrid_vect)

# =============================
# 8. Guardar y visualizar
# =============================
terra::writeRaster(eurodem_madrid, 
                   "/media/enero/Disco3ATA/Varios/R/Archivos/GIS/data/eurogeographics/EuroDEM/eurodem_madrid.tif", 
                   overwrite = TRUE)

plot(eurodem_madrid, main = "EuroDEM - Municipio de Madrid")
plot(sf::st_geometry(madrid_sf), add = TRUE, border = "red", col = NA, lwd = 2)

message("Proceso completado. Archivo guardado como eurodem_madrid.tif")
```

## Info


Acabamos con la información de la sesión con `sessionInfo()`. Esto lo incluimos para en caso de error facilitar el seguimiento del mismo.

```{r}
sessionInfo()
```

Los siguientes bloques no los ejecuto porque contienen información del sistema que podría ser algo sensible.

```{r}
#| eval: false

Sys.getenv()
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

Sys.info()
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

benchmarkme::get_sys_details()
```

Estas funciones nos permite, por ejemplo, guardar la versíón de R en una variable. 

```{r}
version_r <- sessionInfo()$R.version$version.string
version_r
```
